name: launcher-rebuild
comment: Rebuilding a game project from inside the launcher, then running it. This is the Unity-shaped loop the whole design exists for: edit C# or Content/, press a button, play — no C++ build, no process restart. Rebuild republishes the assembly and refreshes the runtime copy of the project's Content/. Driven through the game.rebuild cvar, the same request Flappy's Rebuild button makes: clicking the button by pixel broke whenever the menu layout changed. A publish takes seconds, hence the generous timeout.

steps.comment: Rebuilding is not playing: the request must not have launched anything.
The freshly published assembly is what actually loaded.
